finding: A premerge-check-ok marker written before a stop stays valid during the stop, so git merge passes for that branch head. premerge-check returns at lines 393-398 without touching .current-work/premerge-check-ok, and block-dangerous-git.sh compares only the branch name and the head. BR-091 says the merge is denied because no marker is written, and that holds only when no earlier marker exists. BR-091 also forbids the refusing script to change a file. So add the stop check to block-dangerous-git.sh before it accepts the marker, or change BR-091 so that the refusal removes the marker.
why_this_severity: Every premerge-check during the stop refuses and writes no marker, and a new branch head has no valid marker, so the stop holds on the normal path (no to fails_purpose). A merge passes only when the finding arrives between a passing premerge-check and the merge of the same head, and then the operator must find and reverse that merge.
